pitches.title: Close the loop on maternal danger reports (pregnancy and nifas): handled-by, outcome, staff escalation
pitches.user: Kader, bidan/doctor, officer, pregnant or postpartum mother
pitches.job: Make sure every maternal danger sign reaches a person who acts and the mother reaches a facility within 24 h
pitches.outcome: Maternal deaths from haemorrhage, eclampsia and sepsis fall when the delay to care shrinks. Today a report is one Kader ping with no owner, no outcome, and it expires after 3 days; postpartum reports do not even raise risk.
pitches.evidence: backend/app/routers/maternal.py:400-403 notifies only ['kader'] (child emergencies notify kader+officer+doctor, services/assessment.py:308); models.py:506-514 PregnancyDangerReport has no handled/outcome fields and never becomes a case; maternal.py:141 urgent flag drops after 3 days regardless of action; maternal.py:143 recent_danger counts only when p.status == 'active', so a nifas report does not raise risk
pitches.smallest_version: Also notify doctor and officer; add handled_at, handled_by and outcome (went_to_facility, advised_home, not_reached) to PregnancyDangerReport; 'Sudah saya hubungi' then outcome buttons on the Kader's view of the mother; keep her 'urgent' until handled (not 3 days); count nifas reports in risk; dashboard tile 'Tanda bahaya belum ditanggapi' with hours waiting
pitches.risks: No push, so the alert is still seen only when staff open the app (in-app only); outcome is self-reported by the Kader; escalation thresholds (2 h) to validate with the Puskesmas

pitches.title: Posyandu-day list: immunisation/vitamin A due chip on the Kader list plus monthly D/S
pitches.job: On posyandu day, know which children are due for immunisation, vitamin A or deworming and how many were weighed this month
pitches.outcome: Higher D/S catches growth faltering (T/2T) earlier; catching overdue immunisation and vitamin A cuts the infections that drive stunting
pitches.evidence: ai/kia.py:42 schedule() computes due/overdue but is used only per child (routers/child_care.py:26-29); Kader list routers/dashboard.py:196-266 has no KIA filter; live API: 25 of 49 children have >=1 due/overdue KIA item, findable only by opening each child; /api/dashboard/summary has measured_children (ever) and no D/S for the month
pitches.smallest_version: Compute imm_due per row from kia.schedule in /api/dashboard/children, add a 'Jatuh tempo imunisasi / Vitamin A' chip on KaderHome with the item named on each row; add a 'Ditimbang bulan ini X dari Y' tile (calendar month) for Kader and officer
pitches.risks: kia.schedule per child per request may be slow at scale (cache or batch); demo seed has all children measured today, so D/S shows 100% in the demo; KIA data is only as complete as marking by mothers or Kaders

pitches.title: Kader registers any family (non-pregnant mother without an account) and resets a mother's forgotten password
pitches.user: Kader, mother without her own account or locked out
pitches.job: Get every under-5 child in the village into the system, and get a locked-out mother back in
pitches.outcome: The highest-risk families (no account, shared phone) become visible to D/S, triage and alerts; locked-out mothers regain logged-in danger reporting and guidance
pitches.evidence: routers/children.py:44-47 returns 404 'register the caregiver first' when no account; the only Kader registration path is /kader/mothers (maternal.py:239) and it requires a pregnancy; mobile/src/lib/i18n.ts:1491 promises 'Minta kata sandi baru ke Kader atau Puskesmas' but the only password endpoint is self change-password (auth.py:144)
pitches.smallest_version: In 'Tambah anak', if the phone is unknown, create the caregiver inline like register_mother (temporary password, witnessed verbal consent, audit); add POST /kader/mothers/{id}/reset-password limited to the Kader's coverage, bumping token_version, audited, notifying the mother, showing the temporary password once
pitches.risks: A Kader could take over an account (mitigation: coverage limit, audit, notice to the mother, token_version bump); families with no phone at all still cannot log in themselves (the Kader holds the record)

keep.feature: Danger-first escalation (symptom tiles to 'Perlu pertolongan' with Puskesmas/119/Kader; offline-queued maternal danger report that still shows call buttons; Nuri danger-first answers)
keep.why: This is the core safety behaviour, verified in danger.tsx:36-50 and tests B13, C2, D7

keep.feature: WHO-rule triage, cases and Kader alerts independent of the AI consent
keep.why: Refusing AI never switches off safety (children.py:232, :405)

keep.feature: doctor_48h referral as the mother's first action with the Puskesmas call button
keep.why: The mother now knows to see a doctor and has the number to call (AssessmentView.tsx:64-76, :143)

keep.feature: Kader registration of pregnant mothers with witnessed verbal consent and a temporary password
keep.why: It reaches mothers without email and is the pattern PM-3 reuses (maternal.py:239-290)

keep.feature: FHIR inbound with per-mother consent, idempotent resends and hashed facility keys
keep.why: Standard, secure integration that works and is tested (E3)
